PhD by Research Programme
A research-intensive PhD programme designed to develop future researchers in biomedical and health sciences.
The LKCMedicine PhD by Research Programme admits students from diverse academic backgrounds, including natural sciences, medicine, engineering, computing and social sciences.
Graduates gain deep expertise in scientific fundamentals and translational medical research methods, equipping them to conduct rigorous, impactful research and contribute to advances in biomedical science and healthcare.
Discover the LKCMedicine PhD Experience
Assoc Prof Christine Cheung
Assistant Dean (PhD Studies and Professional Development)
Lee Kong Chian School of Medicine
Message from Associate Professor Christine Cheung
Programme Director
I always have the privilege of witnessing the full circle of a PhD journey at LKCMedicine. From reconnecting with our alumni and learning about the impact they are making, to celebrating graduates who transform years of dedication into remarkable achievements. Watching our PhD scholars arrive with curiosity and ambition, navigate the uncertainties and challenges of research, and grow into confident individuals ready to solve real-world problems is just as rewarding.
To our new PhD scholars: a PhD is more than a degree. It is a journey that shapes biomedical leaders, clinician scientists and innovators who will challenge the status quo. Your questions today are the solutions of tomorrow. We're proud to support you every step of the way.
Our Vision
Cultivating pioneering researchers and leaders
To cultivate the next generation of pioneering researchers and leaders in medical science through a PhD programme that emphasises innovation, collaboration and excellence.
We aim to provide a transformative educational experience that meets the unique needs of both clinician and research scholars, fostering an inclusive environment where cutting-edge research and medical knowledge advance.
Opening pathways to research, healthcare and innovation
Our graduates pursue diverse careers across biomedical research, academia, healthcare, the life sciences industry and the public sector, contributing to scientific discovery, healthcare innovation and advances in biomedical science.
Biomedical Research & Academia
Healthcare & Clinical Research

Government & Public Health

Science & Technology
Distinctive Features
The LKCMedicine PhD by Research Programme offers a unique research training environment that extends beyond disciplinary boundaries. Through opportunities such as laboratory rotations, clinical and global health attachments, and support for conference participation, students gain broad exposure to diverse research perspectives, healthcare challenges, and international scientific communities.
These experiences enrich their research journey, foster interdisciplinary thinking, and equip them to conduct impactful research that advances biomedical science and healthcare.
Journey to Achievement
Every PhD journey is a story of curiosity, perseverance, and discovery. At LKCMedicine, our students are supported throughout their research training as they develop new knowledge, overcome scientific challenges, and contribute to advances in biomedical and health sciences. Through their dedication and achievements, they exemplify the impact that research can have on improving lives and shaping the future of healthcare.
